H.866 is a petition filed by Rogers to let cities and towns extend voting rights in municipal elections to certain non-citizens of the Commonwealth. Related to non-citizen voting; it does not address ID or proof of citizenship directly.

Filed by David M. Rogers. H.866 would let cities and towns that accept it by local ballot question put non-citizens aged 18 or older on a local voter list for municipal elections only. Registration forms would carry a declaration, signed under penalty of perjury, of residence and intent to seek citizenship. It says nothing confers a right to vote in state or federal contests. Similar bill filed in the previous session (House No. 712). Referred to the Election Laws committee.
